why.event_updates: You're getting this because you're on the guest list for an event by {org}.
why.marketing: You're getting this because you subscribed to news from {org}.

orders.tickets.subject: Your tickets for {eventName}
orders.tickets.intro: {count, plural, =0 {Your order is confirmed.} one {Your ticket is ready.} other {Your # tickets are ready.}} Keep this email: the button below opens them anytime.

orders.refund.subject: Your refund for {eventName}
orders.refund.intro: {fully, select, yes {Your order was refunded in full:} other {Part of your order was refunded:}} {amount}. It can take 5–10 business days to reach your account.

tenancy.invitation.subject: You're invited to join {orgName} on Yayatoh
tenancy.invitation.intro: {orgName} invited you to join their team as {role}.

tenancy.event-invitation.subject: You're invited to help with {eventName}
tenancy.event-invitation.intro: {orgName} invited you to {eventName} as {role}. You'll see this event only.

ticketing.claim-link.subject: A ticket for {eventName} is waiting for you
ticketing.claim-link.intro: Someone passed you a ticket for {eventName}. Claim it to get your own QR code.

ticketing.holder-link.subject: Your link to your tickets for {eventName}
ticketing.holder-link.intro: Here is the link you asked for. It opens your tickets for {eventName}.

ticketing.tickets-resent.subject: Your ticket for {eventName}
ticketing.tickets-resent.intro: The organizer of {eventName} sent you your ticket {code} again. The button below opens your tickets anytime.

ticketing.ticket-cancelled.subject: Your ticket for {eventName} was cancelled
ticketing.ticket-cancelled.intro: The organizer of {eventName} cancelled your ticket {code}. It no longer admits you. If you have questions, reply to the organizer.

seating.finder-code.subject: {code} is your seat finder code for {eventName}
seating.finder-code.intro: Enter {code} on the seat finder to see your seat. The code works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

attendees.message.subject: {subject}
attendees.message.intro: A message from the organizer of {eventName}:

sales.order_paid.subject: New order: {name}
sales.order_paid.intro: {name} bought {count, plural, one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} for {eventName} ({amount}).

payments.destination-changed.subject: A new payout account for {org}
payments.destination-changed.intro: {reason, select, bank_changed {The bank account that receives {org}'s payouts was changed.} other {A payout account was connected to {org}.}} For your security, no money is sent to it before {until}. If you didn't make this change, contact Yayatoh support right away.

tenancy.staff-access.subject: Yayatoh support is acting as {member} in {org}
tenancy.staff-access.intro: A Yayatoh staff member started acting as {member} in {org} to help. Reason: {reason}. This access ends by {until}. While it lasts, nothing can be refunded, paid out, exported or deleted, and everything done appears in your activity log. If you didn't expect this, contact Yayatoh support right away.

tenancy.org-status.subject: {status, select, suspended {Yayatoh suspended {org}} reactivated {{org} is back online} other {Yayatoh closed {org}}}
tenancy.org-status.intro: {status, select, suspended {Yayatoh support suspended {org}. Its public pages and ticket sales are offline and the console is read-only. Tickets already sold stay valid and can still be scanned at the door. Contact Yayatoh support to find out more.} reactivated {Yayatoh support reactivated {org}. Its public pages, listings and ticket sales are back, and the console works as before.} other {Yayatoh support closed {org}. Its public pages are offline and it can't be changed any more. As an owner you can still open it and download your data. Contact Yayatoh support if you think this is a mistake.}}

surveys.invite.subject: {title}
surveys.invite.intro: {org} would like to hear how {eventName} went for you. It takes about two minutes.

surveys.reminder.subject: Reminder: {title}
surveys.reminder.intro: You haven't answered yet: {org} would still like to hear how {eventName} went for you.

guest.checkout-code.subject: {code} is your code to confirm your email
guest.checkout-code.intro: Enter {code} to confirm your email and finish your order with {org}. The code works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

guest.sign-in.subject: {code} is your code for My tickets
guest.sign-in.intro: Enter {code} to see your tickets on {site}, or use the button below in the same browser. The code expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}} and the button in {linkMinutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}; each works once. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

guest.waitlist-code.subject: {code} is your code to join the waitlist
guest.waitlist-code.intro: Enter {code} to confirm your email and join the waitlist for {eventName} with {org}. The code works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

orders.waitlist-joined.subject: You're on the waitlist for {eventName}
orders.waitlist-joined.intro: You're number {position} in line for {count, plural, one {# {passName} ticket} other {# {passName} tickets}} to {eventName}. If tickets free up, we'll email you an offer to check out; it holds the tickets for a limited time. Use the link below to see your place or leave the waitlist.

orders.waitlist-offer.subject: Tickets are free for {eventName}: check out by {until}
orders.waitlist-offer.intro: Good news: {org} is holding {count, plural, one {# {passName} ticket} other {# {passName} tickets}} to {eventName} for you until {until}. Check out before then; after that, the tickets go to the next person in line.

orders.waitlist-expired.subject: Your offer for {eventName} has ended
orders.waitlist-expired.intro: The time to check out your {passName} tickets to {eventName} ran out, so they went to the next person in line. You can rejoin the waitlist at the back of the line from the link below.

orders.order-link.subject: {reason, select, reissued {Your new link to your order for {eventName}} other {Your link to your order for {eventName}}}
orders.order-link.intro: {reason, select, reissued {The organizer replaced the link to your order for {eventName}. The old link no longer works; use this one.} other {Here is the link you asked for. It opens your order and tickets for {eventName}.}}

security.fraud_signal.subject: Fraud alert: {signal, select, two_entrances {the same ticket at two entrances} impossible_travel {impossible travel between checkpoints} device_velocity {a scanner scanning too fast} invalid_burst {a burst of invalid codes} rejected_burst {a burst of refused scans} purchase_velocity {many orders from one buyer} country_mismatch {a buyer in another country} checkout_blocked {a blocked checkout} card_testing {possible card testing} chat_abuse {a reported conversation} other {a fraud signal}}
security.fraud_signal.intro: A high-severity signal needs a look at {org}{eventName, select, none {} other { ({eventName})}}: {signal, select, two_entrances {the same ticket at two entrances} impossible_travel {impossible travel between checkpoints} device_velocity {a scanner scanning too fast} invalid_burst {a burst of invalid codes} rejected_burst {a burst of refused scans} purchase_velocity {many orders from one buyer} country_mismatch {a buyer in another country} checkout_blocked {a blocked checkout} card_testing {possible card testing} chat_abuse {a reported conversation} other {a fraud signal}}. Open it to acknowledge or dismiss it.

messaging.auto_paused.subject: Messaging paused for {org}
messaging.auto_paused.intro: Complaints about {org}'s emails reached {rate}, above the 0.3% limit, so Yayatoh paused your reminders, updates and marketing. Tickets, receipts and replies still go out. Yayatoh support will review it with you before messaging resumes.

orders.refund-requested.subject: Refund request: {name}
orders.refund-requested.intro: {name} asked for a refund of {count, plural, =0 {their order} one {# ticket} other {# tickets}} for {eventName}. Answer it within 5 business days.

orders.refund-declined.subject: Your refund request for {eventName}
orders.refund-declined.intro: The organizer of {eventName} declined your refund request: “{reason}” Your tickets stay valid.

events.postponed.subject: {eventName} is postponed
events.postponed.intro: {eventName} has been postponed. Your tickets stay valid for the new date. If you can’t make it, you can ask for a refund from your order page under the organizer’s refund policy.

payments.dispute-deadline.intro: The evidence for a {amount} dispute on an order for {eventName} is due in {hours, plural, =0 {less than an hour} one {# hour} other {# hours}}. Review it and submit it before the deadline.

ticketing.transfer-offered.intro: {fromName} is transferring a ticket for {eventName} to you. Claim it with this email address to get your own QR code.

ticketing.transfer-completed.intro: {toName} claimed the ticket you transferred for {eventName}. Your old QR code no longer works.

ticketing.transfer-received.intro: You claimed the ticket {fromName} sent you for {eventName}. Your own QR code is ready.

forms.resume.subject: Continue your registration for {eventName}
forms.resume.intro: Here is your link to pick up your registration for {eventName} where you left off. It works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} after your last save and only for you, so please don't forward it. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

portal.invite.subject: You're invited to the {eventName} portal
portal.invite.intro: {org} invited you to the portal for {eventName} as {role}. There you can see your sessions, update your profile and complete your tasks. The button asks for a sign-in code sent to this address.

portal.sign-in.subject: {code} is your sign-in code for {eventName}
portal.sign-in.intro: Enter {code} to sign in to the {eventName} portal, or use the button below in the same browser. Code valid for: {minutes} min. Button valid for: {linkMinutes} min. Each works once. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email.

program.task-reminder.intro: {org} is still waiting for “{title}” for {eventName}. Due: {until}.

privacy.request-code.subject: {code} is your code to confirm your privacy request
privacy.request-code.intro: Enter {code} to confirm your request to {org} for {kind, select, erasure {erasing your personal data} other {a copy of your personal data}}. The code works once and expires in {minutes, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}. If you didn't ask for it, you can ignore this email: nothing happens without the code.

privacy.archive-ready.subject: Your personal data from {org} is ready
privacy.archive-ready.intro: {org} answered your request: a copy of the personal data it holds about you is ready as a ZIP file. The link works for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. The archive is signed, so you can check it was not changed.

privacy.erasure-done.subject: {org} erased your personal data
privacy.erasure-done.intro: {org} erased your personal data as you asked. Some records must be kept by law (for example paid orders for tax), with your name and email removed; the receipt lists them and why. This is the last email you will get about it.

deleted.subject: Your Yayatoh account was deleted
deleted.intro:
As you asked, your Yayatoh account has been deleted. You've been signed out everywhere, and your sign-in details and two-step verification were removed. Organizers you bought from keep their order records, as the law requires.

If you didn't ask for this, reply to this email at once.

account.sentBy: Sent by Yayatoh about your account.

cutover.sentBy: Sent by Yayatoh about the move to its new platform.

t14.subject: Yayatoh moves to its new platform on {start}
t14.intro:
On {start} Yayatoh moves to its new platform. For about 45 minutes, until {end}, your dashboard and ticket sales are paused; check-in at the door keeps working and tickets already sold stay valid.

Your events, orders, payouts and team come with you, and you sign in with the same email and password. There is nothing you need to do: we'll write again two days before and when it's done.

t2.subject: Reminder: Yayatoh maintenance on {start}
t2.intro: A reminder: on {start}, until about {end}, Yayatoh is read-only while we move to the new platform. Please don't plan an on-sale or a ticket push in that window. Check-in at the door keeps working and tickets already sold stay valid.

freezeStart.subject: Yayatoh maintenance has started
freezeStart.intro: Yayatoh is read-only while we move to the new platform, until about {end}. You can still look at your events and scan tickets at the door; saving changes, new sales and refunds are paused. We'll email you when it's done.

freezeEnd.subject: Yayatoh is back on its new platform
freezeEnd.intro: The move is done and Yayatoh works again. Sign in as usual with the same email and password: your events, orders and payouts are all there, and tickets already sold stay valid. If you use the Yayatoh app, update it from your app store.

rollback.subject: Yayatoh is back on the previous version
rollback.intro: We moved Yayatoh back to the previous version while we fix a problem with the new platform. Sales and changes made since {start} have been kept, and tickets stay valid. Sign in as before; we'll tell you the new date for the move.

t14.subject: Your tickets stay valid during our move on {start}
t14.intro:
On {start} Yayatoh moves to its new platform. For about 45 minutes, until {end}, you can't buy tickets or change orders, but the tickets you have stay valid and are scanned at the door as usual.

Afterwards you sign in with the same email and password. If you use the Yayatoh app, update it once we tell you the move is done.

t2.subject: Reminder: short Yayatoh maintenance on {start}
t2.intro: A reminder: on {start}, until about {end}, you can't buy tickets or change orders on Yayatoh. Your tickets stay valid and work at the door.

freezeStart.subject: Yayatoh maintenance has started
freezeStart.intro: Ticket sales and order changes on Yayatoh are paused until about {end} while we move to the new platform. Your tickets stay valid and are scanned at the door as usual.

freezeEnd.subject: Yayatoh is back
freezeEnd.intro: The move is done: you can buy tickets and manage your orders again. Your tickets stay valid, and you sign in with the same email and password. If you use the Yayatoh app, update it from your app store.

rollback.subject: Yayatoh is back on the previous version
rollback.intro: We moved Yayatoh back to the previous version while we fix a problem. Tickets you bought since {start} stay valid. If we had to refund one of your orders, you'll get a separate email with the amount. Sign in as before.

campaigns.testBanner: Test email: only your team received this. Merge fields show their fallbacks.
